"Search your deck for an ARROW card, reveal it, then shuffle your deck and put it on top of your deck." The arrow restriction was a nested `filter` dict holding a CARD_IN_ZONE -- a key SEARCH_DECK does not read, and a condition that COUNTS cards in a zone rather than testing a candidate, so it could not have worked as a filter either. With no filter the search matched ANY card and fetched whatever was first: a search that names a card and returns a different one is worse than a search that fails.

The whole ability was also gated on CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE "Azalea". "Azalea Specialization" is a DECKBUILDING restriction -- the card may only go in an Azalea deck, which slug_index records under legalHeroes -- not a game state to test, and Azalea is a hero, not a token you control. The gate was false in every game, so the card did nothing at all.
